principle: formal information continuity, not physical or subjective immortality

dimensions.goal: reconstruct encoded finite state after hardware replacement
restore AI workflow and event history with explicit provenance
dimensions.test: replay event log in isolated fixture and compare state
dimensions.boundary: not evidence of subjective identity or AGI

dimensions.test: independent clinical review and measured outcomes
dimensions.boundary: no proven human immortality or autonomous medical action

dimensions.goal: reduce potential suffering in animal and cultivated-protein systems
dimensions.test: ethical review and welfare risk assessments
dimensions.boundary: no proof of absence of sentience or suffering

dimensions.goal: improve long-run ecological resilience and sustainability
support peace and sustainable development governance
preserve optional personal or cultural narratives with consent
dimensions.test: reversible export, access control and deletion test
dimensions.boundary: record continuity is not personal survival

dimensions.goal: permit non-coercive symbolic research on cosmic love and G
dimensions.test: clear labeling of assumptions and counterexamples
dimensions.boundary: no demonstration of theological or physical claims
